source.archive_scope: Operational events list, including trajectory milestones, commanding, and DSN downlink times; the list is not a maneuver-vector or radiometric measurement product
source.rights: Official PDS public access; redistribution and derivative publication rights not yet reviewed; raw file remains ignored locally

time_conversion: ET seconds from J2000 TDB converted to UTC with local astropy 7.2.0 leap-second table before reading the events CSV

search_contract.window_rule: event interval overlaps [arc start, arc end); if an event has no end, use its start as a point event
search_contract.report: all event counts in each arc, keyword-hit counts and event identifiers/time/type; matching context events are diagnostic only

admission_gates.event_time_in_fixed_arc: Only a product row whose event interval overlaps a frozen arc can establish a candidate actual event in that arc
admission_gates.desaturation_identity: An event must explicitly identify desaturation or momentum unloading; generic maneuver, commanding, or wheel activity is insufficient
admission_gates.impulse_vector: Requires an independent product with time, reference frame, direction and magnitude; this events CSV is not presumed to contain it
admission_gates.independent_observable: Requires raw tracking or another measurement with product-level time coverage and a reviewed observation model
